# runzero_export_tokens (Data Source)

Fetches a list of RunZero export tokens.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `org_id` (String) The organization ID to list export tokens for.

### Read-Only

- `export_tokens` (Attributes List) List of export tokens. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--export_tokens))

<a id="nestedatt--export_tokens"></a>
### Nested Schema for `export_tokens`

Read-Only:

- `comment` (String) A comment for the export token.
- `counter` (Number) Total usage counter.
- `created_at` (Number) Unix timestamp when the export token was created.
- `id` (String) The UUID of the export token.
- `last_used_at` (Number) Unix timestamp when the token was last used.
- `last_used_by` (String) Identifier of the last user of the token.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) The export token value.
